notablePrerequisites: You have at least {E}{E}{E}{E} plus an additional {E} if the extra creature has mana value equal to 3.
easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less.
description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Kheru Goldkeeper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kheru Goldkeeper enters, Twilight Diviner's second ability triggers, creating a token copy of Kheru Goldkeeper.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing Twilight Diviner and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning the creature sacrificed in step 1 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Both Kheru Goldkeepers trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
